name: Notstrom and the cards
format: WAV for the loops, mono MP3 for the rest
note: The map ambience and the sounds of the cards and of Energy. Not tied to a Hero. 'ambience.loops' run for the whole match; 'oneShots' play at random now and then, quietly. 'ui' sounds answer the player's own actions.

loop.bed.what: Notstrom ground bed: a huge slow ventilation fan, seamless loop (WAV: MP3 leaves a gap at the seam)

sfx.vent.what: ventilation duct releases a burst of air

ui.shuffle.what: one riffle of a shuffle; two of them make the shuffle

ui.card-played-1.what: a card goes into the Queue

ui.card-played-2.what: a card goes into the Queue

ui.card-draw.what: a card is drawn into the Hand (one per card, as it leaves the Deck pile)

ui.card-burn.what: a card burns into the Exile (Deck Damage): once per hit, however many cards burn

loop.laser-hum.what: the laser barrier around the inactive Prime Zone: a low hum like a laser sword, seamless loop (WAV)

ui.laser-off.what: the laser barrier flickers and powers down when the Prime Zone becomes active

ui.zone-taken.what: the player's Squad takes a zone: a short capture stinger

ui.score.what: the Squad earns Credits: a cash register ka-ching

ui.countdown-tick.what: a big number of the planning countdown appears (10, 5, 4, 3, 2): a low wumpf

ui.countdown-final.what: the last big number (1): a long low duud

loop.scout-drone.what: quadcopter scout drone hovering: a dark, soft, steady hum, seamless loop (WAV)

ui.hangar-spark.what: sparks jumping from a damaged fuse box in the hangar of the Hero Select

loops.note: louder the nearer the player's Hero is to the Prime Zone

barrier.note: hums while the Prime Zone is inactive (the red laser walls stand), louder the nearer the player's Hero; the dissolve sounds when the walls flicker out

scoutDrone.note: hums while the player's Squad has a Scout Drone area out (Site Survey, two Resolutions), louder the nearer the player's Hero is to the nearest area

spark.note: at the start of every spark of the two fuse boxes in the picture of the hangar (the scene tells when)

shuffle.note: the two riffles of the shuffle animation (deck-shuffle.ts)

cardBurn.note: starts when the glowing edge appears, 14 % into the 900 ms of the first card's burn (burn-glimmer.ts)
